assets.prompt: A sheet of 96x96 frames of a floating living staff at 2x detail (two art pixels a world pixel, drawn at half size in the game) for a top-down 32x32-unit pixel game: a faceted bipyramid crystal in the player colour, each facet lit by the light from the top-left, a bright ridge down its face and a white glint, held in a flared wooden collar, on a straight Wood shaft with grain lines and a gold butt cap. Its 48x48 sheet's silhouette and size kept. Each pixel shaded by its surface's facing against the light from the top-left in three shades a material, the brightest spots a Bone light glint; a one-pixel dark outline round the outside and a dark seam where the head sits on the wood. The grip at (48, 54) of every frame. 16 columns, the staff pointing clockwise from right in 22.5 degree steps, each drawn, never rotated; 4 rows, the head in each player colour ramp (blue, rose, green, purple). An indexed PNG of palette colours from docs/STYLE.md, every pixel fully clear or fully opaque.
